title: RTPS: Parse TypeObjectV2 built-in annotations
description:
- Adds parsing of built-in annotations for TypeObjectV2 from the DDS X-Types 1.3 specification.
- Adds entity IDs for Secure TypeLookup readers and writers
- Fixes parsing of emheaders (enhanced mutable headers) when the length code equals 4
- Fixes parsing of sequence number when delimited CDR2 is used
- Fixes parsing of delimited headers before lookup requests and replies when delimited CDR2 is used
